Nimbus logs: ``` INF 2024-07-11 11:42:09.895+00:00 Invalid block topics="gossip_blocks" blockRoot=9853337f blck="(slot: 320, proposer_index: 45, parent_root: \"e18ad822\", state_root: \"021883fd\", eth1data: (deposit_root: d70a234731285c6804c2a4f56711ddb8c82c99740f207854891028af34e27e5e, deposit_count: 0, block_hash: 23ae46d7a0cf5c4b9bed64e29c101ebfc18e3d3fdfa110272ed4f1c7625b8402), graffiti: \"1-nethermind-teku TKa5afNM3989\", proposer_slashings_len: 0, attester_slashings_len: 0, attestations_len: 1, deposits_len: 0, voluntary_exits_len: 0, sync_committee_participants: 512, block_number: 317, block_hash: \"0x5f412fb4386fc94e63908c5a4fe2ec1bc03cb27fc82368e373ffb7c9349805c8\", parent_hash: \"0xdaa4343b82fc9ddd7b2b2565efdbc2c2c165603da969d916449f046ce842a79b\", fee_recipient: \"0x8943545177806ed17b9f23f0a21ee5948ecaa776\", bls_to_execution_changes_len: 0, blob_kzg_commitments_len: 0)" error="block: state root verification failed" NTC 2024-07-11 11:42:09.896+00:00 Received invalid block topics="requman" peer=16U*o6ezhw blocks=[9853337f] peer_score=300 ``` It's reliably reproducible at epoch 9 -> 10 transition with all nimbus pairs. Can someone from nimbus team have a look at it? can send more logs / snooper logs etc. if needed 🙂 epoch 10 is the activation epoch for a newly deposited validator with 1000 ETH & `0x02` creds. that's very likely related 🤔 I've added ethereumjs to the matrix, works fine with one exception: the `ethereumjs-grandine` pair keeps stuck in optimistic sync mode. It looks like ethereumjs responds with a 401 to a eth_blockNumber request from grandine why is that needed for optimistic sync? none of the eth_ endpoints are needed for optimistic sync the CL follows the chain, so it is in optimistic sync mode, just can't talk to the EL as expected, so EL never proceeds. In particular I see that failed `eth_blockNumber` in the snooper logs why can't it talk? engine api is failing? yes 👍
